title: Sync Report Evidence
description: Schema for multi-display synchronization evidence collected during Streaming Lab test runs.

testRunId.description: Unique identifier for the test run that produced this sync report.

evidenceType.description: Type of sync evidence collection that produced this report.

streamUrl.description: HLS stream URL used by the displays.

sourceId.description: Logical stream/source identifier, such as camera_sync_test.

displays.description: Per-display observed frame evidence used for comparison.

displayId.description: Identifier for the display/browser instance, such as DISPLAY_01.

observedFrameNumber.description: Visible frame number observed from the FFmpeg overlay.

observedPts.description: Visible PTS timestamp observed from the FFmpeg overlay, formatted as HH:MM:SS.mmm.

playbackStatusPath.description: Relative path to this display's playback-status.json file.

screenshotPath.description: Relative path to this display's screenshot evidence.

frameDifference.description: Absolute frame difference between the compared displays.

ptsDifferenceSeconds.description: Absolute PTS difference in seconds between the compared displays.

toleranceSeconds.description: Maximum accepted PTS difference in seconds.

notes.description: Human-readable notes about the sync observation or validation.

capturedAt.description: Timestamp when the sync report was captured.
